name: nstarman-skills
description: Agent skills by Nathaniel Starkman, one plugin per skill. Generated by scripts/build_index.py; do not edit.

plugins.name: diataxis
plugins.description: Audits and restructures documentation into the Diátaxis modes — tutorials, how-to guides, reference and explanation — without breaking links.

plugins.name: engaging-hybrid-compute
plugins.description: Splits a research project between a laptop and MIT's Engaging cluster: edit locally, run Slurm jobs on the cluster, and sync code and results through a private git repo.

plugins.name: figkit
plugins.description: Builds an interactive webapp for a scientific paper with figkit: exports the paper's arrays, ports the per-interaction science to tested JavaScript, composes linked views, and publishes a static site plus a single archivable HTML file that also runs in notebooks.

plugins.name: figkit-upgrade
plugins.description: Moves a figkit webapp to a newer figkit version by applying the changelog's migration notes in order, then rebuilds and re-checks that the app still reproduces the paper's numbers.

plugins.name: quax
plugins.description: Writes, reviews and debugs JAX code that uses quax: custom array-like types such as physical units, sparse and low-rank arrays, quaxify, and the dispatch rules that make them work.

plugins.name: syw-overleaf-dropbox
plugins.description: Guides writing a paper with showyourwork and Overleaf, using the Dropbox copy of the Overleaf project as the local text mirror: where to edit text versus code, how a build pushes figures and numbers, and the stalls and silent non-builds to expect.

plugins.name: unxt
plugins.description: Writes, reviews and debugs code that uses unxt quantities in JAX: units, dimensions and unit systems, conversions, and passing quantities through JAX and quax transformations.
